evidence.text: Definition 1. For a nonempty set R of relevant evidence and a retrieved set S, recall is |R intersection S| / |R|.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. If S is a subset of T, then R intersection S is a subset of R intersection T. Proof: any element in R intersection S belongs to R and S, hence to R and T.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. For fixed nonempty R and S subset T, recall(S) <= recall(T). Proof: Lemma 1 gives |R intersection S| <= |R intersection T|. Divide by the positive |R| and apply Definition 1. This says nothing about precision or answer accuracy.

Fusion-R · 多文档解码融合
Synthetic Research Team · 2021
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
evidence.section: 示例元信息

evidence.text: We extend Atlas-R by encoding each passage independently and fusing representations in the decoder.
evidence.section: 3 Method

evidence.text: Memory use grows with the number of retrieved passages. We leave adaptive passage selection to future work.
evidence.section: 6 Limitations

evidence.text: At a fixed retrieval budget, independent passage encoding improves evidence coverage in our synthetic benchmark.
evidence.section: 4 Evaluation

evidence.text: Definition 1. In one normed vector space, a teaching fusion model is h = sum_i w_i h_i, for finitely many nonnegative weights with sum_i w_i = 1. This simplified model is not a description of a real decoder.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. For nonnegative weights and vectors in the same normed vector space, norm(sum_i w_i(h_i-h*)) <= sum_i w_i norm(h_i-h*). Proof: apply the triangle inequality and positive homogeneity of the norm.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. Under Definition 1, if Assumption 1 holds, then norm(h-h*) <= epsilon. Proof: Definition 1 gives h-h* = sum_i w_i(h_i-h*). Lemma 1 bounds its norm by sum_i w_i epsilon = epsilon, using Assumption 1. This does not guarantee factual accuracy or apply to arbitrary nonlinear decoders.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Assumption 1. Every input representation satisfies norm(h_i-h*) <= epsilon, with epsilon >= 0. This is an assumption, not a measured empirical guarantee.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Corollary 1. If all h_i equal h*, the fused representation equals h*. Proof: apply Theorem 1 with epsilon = 0. A vector at norm distance zero equals h*. This concerns the teaching vector model only.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Lemma 1 · 加权误差上界
nodes.statement: 对非负权重，有 ‖Σ wᵢ(hᵢ − h*)‖ ≤ Σ wᵢ‖hᵢ − h*‖。
conditions: 所有向量属于同一赋范向量空间

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 融合表示误差界
nodes.statement: 若每个表示与目标 h* 的距离至多为 ε，则该加权融合表示与 h* 的距离也至多为 ε。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的融合模型

nodes.label: Assumption 1 · 单表示误差约束
nodes.statement: 所有输入表示满足 ‖hᵢ − h*‖ ≤ ε，其中 ε ≥ 0。

nodes.label: Corollary 1 · 精确输入的融合
nodes.statement: 若所有输入表示都等于 h*，则融合表示也等于 h*。
conditions: Definition 1 的非负归一化权重

evidence.text:
Loop-R · 迭代证据检索
Synthetic Research Team · 2022
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
evidence.section: 示例元信息

evidence.text: Loop-R retrieves again using an intermediate answer as a reformulated query.
evidence.section: 3 Method

evidence.text: An incorrect intermediate answer may redirect retrieval to irrelevant passages.
evidence.section: 6 Limitations

evidence.text: Additional retrieval rounds increase evidence coverage on two-hop questions in this controlled setting.
evidence.section: 4 Evaluation

evidence.text: Definition 1. Let U be a fixed finite evidence universe. Starting with S_0 subset U, the teaching retrieval loop updates S_(t+1) = S_t union R_t, where R_t subset U. Previously collected evidence is never removed.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. Under Definition 1, every strict update increases |S_t| by at least one and keeps S_t inside the fixed finite U. Proof: Definition 1 uses union with R_t subset U; a strict update adds at least one previously absent element.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. In the finite cumulative model of Lemma 1, at most |U|-|S_0| strict updates can occur. Proof: Lemma 1 gives |S_k| >= |S_0|+k and S_k subset U, so k <= |U|-|S_0|. Repeated non-expanding retrieval is outside this bound.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Corollary 1. If each retrieval terminates and the loop stops on its first non-expanding retrieval, at most |U|-|S_0|+1 retrievals execute. Proof: Theorem 1 bounds strict updates by |U|-|S_0|; the stopping rule permits at most one final non-expanding retrieval.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Definition 1 · 累积证据集合
nodes.statement: 定义第 t 轮累积证据 Sₜ，更新规则为 Sₜ₊₁ = Sₜ ∪ Rₜ，其中 Rₜ 为本轮检索结果。
conditions: 证据来自固定有限集合 U
不删除已经收集的证据

nodes.label: Lemma 1 · 新增证据计数
nodes.statement: 在 Definition 1 的累积模型下，每次严格扩展都使 |Sₜ| 至少增加 1。
conditions: 每次继续更新满足 Sₜ ⊂ Sₜ₊₁

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 有限证据扩展上界
nodes.statement: 若每个继续执行的更新都至少增加一条新证据，则成功扩展次数最多为 |U| − |S₀|。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的累积更新规则
每次继续更新均满足 Sₜ ⊂ Sₜ₊₁

nodes.label: Corollary 1 · 停止规则的轮数界
nodes.statement: 若首次无新增证据时停止，最多执行 |U| − |S₀| + 1 次检索。
conditions: 首次无新增证据立即停止

evidence.text:
Reflect-R · 反思驱动的生成
Synthetic Research Team · 2023
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
evidence.section: 示例元信息

evidence.text: Building on Loop-R, we add a reflection decision before each additional retrieval step.
evidence.section: 3 Method

evidence.text: The reflection classifier requires labeled examples and can fail under domain shift.
evidence.section: 6 Limitations

evidence.text: Skipping unnecessary retrieval reduces the number of retrieval calls in this evaluation.
evidence.section: 4 Evaluation

evidence.text: Definition 1. For finitely many candidate steps with fixed costs c_i >= 0, the baseline cost is B = sum_i c_i. A teaching reflection policy executes subset A and incurs controller overhead H >= 0, so C = H + sum_(i in A) c_i.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. Under Definition 1, B-C = sum_(i not in A) c_i-H. Proof: Definition 1 specifies B and C; partition the finite candidate set into A and its complement and subtract.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. C <= B if and only if sum_(i not in A) c_i >= H. Proof: Lemma 1 gives B-C = sum_(i not in A) c_i-H; C <= B is equivalent to its nonnegativity. No answer-quality guarantee follows.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Proposition 1. If A is the entire candidate set, C = B+H. Proof: in Lemma 1 the complement is empty, so B-C = -H. This branch does not require Theorem 1.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Corollary 1. With uniform step cost c > 0 and k omitted steps, C <= B if and only if kc >= H. Proof: substitute sum_(i not in A) c_i = kc into Theorem 1.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Definition 1 · 检索开销模型
nodes.statement: 设候选检索步骤开销 cᵢ ≥ 0，固定策略执行所有步骤；反思策略仅执行集合 A 中的步骤，另支付控制器开销 H ≥ 0。
conditions: 两种策略使用相同的单步检索开销

nodes.label: Lemma 1 · 总成本差额
nodes.statement: 在 Definition 1 的模型下，B − C = Σᵢ∉A cᵢ − H。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的固定成本模型

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 反思策略节省条件
nodes.statement: 当且仅当省略步骤的检索开销之和不小于 H 时，反思策略的总开销不超过固定策略。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的成本模型

nodes.label: Proposition 1 · 零省略时的额外成本
nodes.statement: 若不省略任何检索步骤，则反思策略总开销为 B + H。
conditions: A 等于完整候选步骤集合

nodes.label: Corollary 1 · 等成本步骤的节省门槛
nodes.statement: 若每步检索成本均为 c > 0，省略 k 步即可节省总开销，当且仅当 kc ≥ H。
conditions: 所有步骤成本等于 c > 0

evidence.text:
Verify-R · 引用支持核验
Synthetic Research Team · 2024
This is an invented demonstration document, not a published paper.
evidence.section: 示例元信息

evidence.text: Each generated statement is paired with a passage and checked for textual support.
evidence.section: 3 Method

evidence.text: Textual support does not establish that the source passage itself is factually correct.
evidence.section: 6 Limitations

evidence.text: Unsupported statements are flagged for manual review rather than silently accepted.
evidence.section: 4 Evaluation

evidence.text: Definition 1. For a fixed finite set Q of statements and fixed textual-support scores s(q) in [0,1], define A_tau = {q in Q: s(q) >= tau}, with tau in [0,1]. Scores measure the teaching checker output, not factual truth.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 1. Under Definition 1, if tau_1 <= tau_2 then A_(tau_2) subset A_(tau_1). Proof: Definition 1 admits q exactly when s(q) reaches the threshold; s(q) >= tau_2 implies s(q) >= tau_1.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Theorem 1. Under Definition 1 and tau_1 <= tau_2, |A_(tau_2)| <= |A_(tau_1)|. Proof: Lemma 1 and Definition 1 give A_(tau_2) subset A_(tau_1); finite set cardinality preserves inclusion. This proves only count monotonicity, not better factual correctness or score calibration.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Lemma 2. Under Definition 1 and tau_1 <= tau_2, A_(tau_1) minus A_(tau_2) = {q in Q: tau_1 <= s(q) < tau_2}. Proof: Definition 1 translates membership and nonmembership into the two score inequalities.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Corollary 1. |A_(tau_1)|-|A_(tau_2)| equals the number of q with tau_1 <= s(q) < tau_2. Proof: Lemma 1 gives nested finite sets, so their cardinality difference equals the set-difference cardinality. Lemma 2 identifies that difference with the score interval.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

evidence.text: Corollary 2. If no statement score lies in [tau_1,tau_2), the two thresholds accept the same number of statements. Proof: Corollary 1 gives a cardinality difference of zero. No factual-truth claim is implied.
evidence.section: 原创数学教学样例 · 非真实论文

nodes.label: Definition 1 · 支持分数阈值集
nodes.statement: 对固定的有限陈述集合 Q，给定固定文本支持分数 s(q) ∈ [0,1]，定义通过集合 Aτ = {q ∈ Q : s(q) ≥ τ}。
conditions: Q 和各陈述分数固定

conditions: 两次筛选使用相同分数

nodes.label: Theorem 1 · 通过数量单调性
nodes.statement: 在陈述和分数固定时，提高阈值不会增加通过的陈述数量，即 |Aτ₂| ≤ |Aτ₁|。
conditions: 采用 Definition 1 的固定集合与分数

nodes.statement: 提高阈值后减少的通过数量，等于分数位于 [τ₁, τ₂) 的陈述数量。

nodes.label: Corollary 2 · 无区间分数时数量不变
nodes.statement: 若没有陈述分数位于 [τ₁, τ₂)，提高阈值不会改变通过数量。
conditions: 区间 [τ₁, τ₂) 内无陈述分数

summary.text: 这组教学样例依次展示了稠密检索、多文档融合、迭代检索、反思控制和引用核验。时间顺序不自动构成继承关系。

directions.title: 让检索预算随证据需求变化
directions.problem: 多文档融合的内存开销与额外检索调用需要控制。
directions.hypothesis: 依据证据覆盖动态选择段落和检索轮数，可能在相近回答质量下减少开销。
directions.reasoning: Fusion-R 指出段落数量带来的内存问题；Reflect-R 展示检索调用可以按需跳过。这只构成实验动机。
directions.experiment: 固定生成模型与数据划分，对比固定段落数和自适应策略；记录答案质量、证据覆盖、内存和检索调用次数。
directions.failure_condition: 若覆盖率显著下降或控制器自身成本抵消节省，则假设不成立。
directions.reason: 示例中前提有依据；假设尚未验证。

directions.title: 检索链错误的早期识别
directions.problem: 中间答案错误可能污染后续检索，反思判断也可能受领域变化影响。
directions.hypothesis: 在新一轮检索前增加原文支持检查，可能降低错误传播。
directions.reasoning: 将 Loop-R 的错误传播风险与 Verify-R 的支持核验思路组合，尚需验证域外表现。
directions.experiment: 构造正确与错误中间答案两组，测量错误检索率、最终正确率与额外时延，并加入域外测试。
directions.failure_condition: 检查器无法识别错误，或引入过多误拒绝。
directions.reason: 组合策略的可行性仍需实验。
